integrity: The published inverse-degree fixation law and finite Markov-state method are acknowledged as prior art. The claimed contribution is a sharp five-vertex threshold and exact seven-class order-five census; exact Fraction calculations and independent interval-state checks are reproducible. No independent scientific validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Connected, finite, simple, unweighted, undirected graphs; neutral discrete-time birth–death updating with mutant fitness equal to resident fitness, a single mutant, and conditional time counted in full update steps. The exhaustive graph census is restricted to orders two through five; the theorem does not cover other updating rules, biased selection, weighted/directed graphs, or larger graph orders.
title: The first degree-tied conditional-fixation-time split in neutral evolutionary networks
